mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer that significantly increases the metabolism of clobazam and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam, reducing their plasma concentrations and anticonvulsant efficacy.
action: Monitor seizure control closely and consider increasing clobazam dose by up to 50% or using alternative antituberculous agents; therapeutic drug monitoring is recommended if available.
